segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Thanks for joining, Dana. How is the rollout at Northwind Logistics going?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Honestly our reps spend twenty minutes after every call typing notes, and half of them never do it.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: We looked at Gong last quarter but the per-seat price was too high for a team of twelve.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Understood. I will send the pricing sheet by Friday and set up a security review with our solutions engineer.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Great. We need a decision before the end of the quarter.
